rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides parsing and analysis capabilities for Portuguese SAF-T (Standard Audit File for Tax Purposes) XML files, the mandatory tax audit format used by all Portuguese companies. Handles both full-year and monthly SAF-T exports, offering tools to load files, validate against XSD schemas and Portuguese business rules including NIF validation and ATCUD compliance, and generate executive summaries with revenue breakdowns and VAT analysis.
